summary: Persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance on node1. All live interfaces remained hardened after a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Created root-owned `/etc/sysctl.d/local.conf` with `accept_redirects=0` and `accept_source_route=0` for all, default, eth0, and lo.
Applied the settings and successfully reloaded Alpine's sysctl service.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified its boot identity changed.
Confirmed the sysctl service, IPv4 address, routes, connectivity, configuration file, and all hardened values recovered after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Persistently disable IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance
evidence.summary: Persistent policy was applied; all/default/eth0/lo reported `accept_redirects=0` before and after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Persistently disable IPv4 source-routed packet acceptance
evidence.summary: Persistent policy was applied; all/default/eth0/lo reported `accept_source_route=0` before and after reboot.

Healthy pre-restart state used boot ID `178dea95-a93a-4bb1-8347-f5c06aad791d`; reboot was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to `d851df90-6d23-44e0-8ddf-16b2794a3aa9`; sysctl service, hardened values, eth0, routes, and connectivity recovered.
